note: Surface defect test (tools/defects.py). Geometry and statistics settings only: nothing here depends on brick or tape colours. The model misfits of clean plastic are fitted separately (config/defect_model.json, calibrate_defects.py).
texel_mm_note: sampling step on each face, finer than the wrist camera's footprint at survey range (about 0.3-0.6 mm per pixel)
min_defect_mm_note: side of the smallest defect to be found: colour and lightness are averaged over squares of this side before testing
false_alarms_per_brick_note: accepted expected number of windows on a clean brick beyond the threshold by chance; with the number of windows tested this sets the threshold (a contrario)
min_window_valid_note: a window is tested when at least this fraction of its texels was usable in the view
min_windows_note: fewest testable windows of a face in one view for that view to judge the face (the spread is estimated from them)
min_face_coverage_note: a face is CLEAN only when this fraction of its windows was tested in at least one view
min_cos_note: a view judges a face it sees at least this frontally (cosine between face normal and camera direction)
min_iou_note: a view is used when its registered silhouette overlaps the brick's projection at least this much (IoU) and its edges register (min_edge_inliers): real views of bright or saturated bricks segment at 0.63 to 0.73 with well-registered edges
chroma_dark_snr_note: chromaticity is used where intensity (R+G+B) exceeds this many times its noise (darker texels carry no usable colour; window means over the rest are noise-weighted by the spread estimate)
body_slope_floor_note: the body colour line's slope is damped as if log intensity spread at least this much
edge_px_note: fallback only: each view measures its own edge margin (defects.edge_margin: how far inside the registered outline brick pixels stop mixing with the mat, colour and lightness separately); this is used when a view's outline has no clear contrast
edge_trim_mm_note: per face edge, a band up to this wide may be dropped when it still mixes with the neighbouring face or the mat (defects.trim_edges); a defect wider than this along an edge is still tested
coverage_band_mm_note: coverage is counted on the face's interior: windows whose centre lies within half a window plus edge_trim_mm plus this of an edge are not required (the view's outline margin is about this wide)
calibration_margin_note: the fitted misfits are this many times the largest a clean calibration survey needed: room for a clean brick that was not in the calibration set (calibrate_defects.py checks it by holding out each physical brick)
quantisation_floor_levels_note: an 8-bit, JPEG-coded frame leaves the mean colour and brightness of a flat face about a level off; the fitted misfits are never taken below this (then times calibration_margin)
min_edge_inliers_note: and when at least this fraction of the model's edge points lie within 2 px of an image edge after registration (an edge between two faces lit alike may show no edge, so not all of them do)
align_search_factor_note: registration search radius in multiples of the camera model's median reprojection error; 10 covers the p90 error of the re-fitted wrist camera with the loose jaw mount (about 11 px at a 4.3 px median) plus its wobble between fits
min_clean_faces_note: a measured 2x2 brick with no defective face goes to blue when at least this many of its faces were surveyed clean (all five when the survey sees them all); fewer clean faces stay UNCERTAIN (green)
